question: Was Petelgeuse’s name change problem over copyright (?) or due to having too many letters? I, too, would rather not have it change.
answer: Nah, it sounds like my manager couldn’t help but laugh when he first saw it, so I wasn’t sure about it. Things like copyright weren’t an issue. It was a battle between me and the manager. (Long story short: The Petelgeuse Renaming Uproar came to a peaceful end without a name change.)
